parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: 设备的主机名，用于标识网络中的设备。

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。

set interfaces ge-2/0/0 unit 1 family in.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set interfaces ge-2/0/0 unit 1 family in.command: set interfaces ge-2/0/0 unit 1 family inet address 10.10.10.1/24
set interfaces ge-2/0/0 unit 1 family in.explanation: 配置接口的IPv4地址及子网掩码。

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。

set system services dhcp-local-server gr.template: set system services dhcp-local-server group [parameter1] interface [parameter2]
set system services dhcp-local-server gr.command: set system services dhcp-local-server group dhcp-group1 interface ge-2/0/0.1
set system services dhcp-local-server gr.explanation: 配置DHCP本地服务器组及其接口。

set access address-assignment pool pool1.template: set access address-assignment pool [parameter1] family inet network [parameter2]/[parameter3]
set access address-assignment pool pool1.command: set access address-assignment pool pool1 family inet network 10.10.10.0/24
set access address-assignment pool pool1.explanation: 配置地址分配池的网络地址及子网掩码。

set access address-assignment pool pool1.template: set access address-assignment pool [parameter1] family inet range [parameter2] low [parameter3]
set access address-assignment pool pool1.command: set access address-assignment pool pool1 family inet range r1 low 10.10.10.2
set access address-assignment pool pool1.explanation: 配置地址分配池的地址范围下限。

set access address-assignment pool pool1.template: set access address-assignment pool [parameter1] family inet range [parameter2] high [parameter3]
set access address-assignment pool pool1.command: set access address-assignment pool pool1 family inet range r1 high 10.10.10.254
set access address-assignment pool pool1.explanation: 配置地址分配池的地址范围上限。

set access address-assignment pool pool1.template: set access address-assignment pool [parameter1] family inet dhcp-attributes router [parameter2]
set access address-assignment pool pool1.command: set access address-assignment pool pool1 family inet dhcp-attributes router 10.10.10.1

set access address-assignment pool pool1.template: set access address-assignment pool [parameter1] family inet dhcp-attributes name-server [parameter2]
set access address-assignment pool pool1.command: set access address-assignment pool pool1 family inet dhcp-attributes name-server 192.168.7.252
set access address-assignment pool pool1.explanation: 配置DHCP属性的DNS服务器地址。

set security zones security-zone trust i.template: set security zones security-zone [parameter1] interfaces [parameter2] host-inbound-traffic system-services [parameter3]
set security zones security-zone trust i.command: set security zones security-zone trust interfaces ge-2/0/0.1 host-inbound-traffic system-services all
set security zones security-zone trust i.explanation: 配置安全区域的接口允许所有系统服务的入站流量。

set security zones security-zone trust i.template: set security zones security-zone [parameter1] interfaces [parameter2] host-inbound-traffic protocols [parameter3]
set security zones security-zone trust i.command: set security zones security-zone trust interfaces ge-2/0/0.1 host-inbound-traffic protocols all
set security zones security-zone trust i.explanation: 配置安全区域的接口允许所有协议的入站流量。

set security zones security-zone untrust.template: set security zones security-zone [parameter1] host-inbound-traffic system-services [parameter2]
set security zones security-zone untrust.command: set security zones security-zone untrust host-inbound-traffic system-services all
set security zones security-zone untrust.explanation: 配置安全区域允许所有系统服务的入站流量。

set security zones security-zone untrust.template: set security zones security-zone [parameter1] host-inbound-traffic protocols [parameter2]
set security zones security-zone untrust.command: set security zones security-zone untrust host-inbound-traffic protocols all
set security zones security-zone untrust.explanation: 配置安全区域允许所有协议的入站流量。

set security nat source pool pool1 addre.template: set security nat source pool [parameter1] address [parameter2] to [parameter3]
set security nat source pool pool1 addre.command: set security nat source pool pool1 address 11.11.11.101 to 11.11.11.105

set security nat source rule-set RS-1 fr.template: set security nat source rule-set [parameter1] from zone [parameter2]
set security nat source rule-set RS-1 fr.command: set security nat source rule-set RS-1 from zone trust
set security nat source rule-set RS-1 fr.explanation: 配置源NAT规则集的源区域。

set security nat source rule-set RS-1 to.template: set security nat source rule-set [parameter1] to zone [parameter2]
set security nat source rule-set RS-1 to.command: set security nat source rule-set RS-1 to zone untrust
set security nat source rule-set RS-1 to.explanation: 配置源NAT规则集应用到指定的安全区域。

set security nat source rule-set RS-1 ru.template: set security nat source rule-set [parameter1] rule [parameter2] match source-address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set security nat source rule-set RS-1 ru.command: set security nat source rule-set RS-1 rule R1 match source-address 10.10.10.0/24
set security nat source rule-set RS-1 ru.explanation: 配置源NAT规则匹配的源地址范围。

parameters.name: subnet-mask
parameters.explanation: 源IP地址范围的子网掩码位数。

set security nat source rule-set RS-1 ru.template: set security nat source rule-set [parameter1] rule [parameter2] then source-nat pool [parameter3]
set security nat source rule-set RS-1 ru.command: set security nat source rule-set RS-1 rule R1 then source-nat pool pool1
set security nat source rule-set RS-1 ru.explanation: 配置源NAT规则的动作，指定使用的NAT池。

set security address-book global address.template: set security address-book global address-set [parameter1] address [parameter2]/[parameter3]
set security address-book global address.command: set security address-book global address-set group1 address 0.0.0.0/0
set security address-book global address.explanation: 配置全局地址簿中的地址集及其地址。

set system radius-server 192.168.7.252 a.explanation: 配置RADIUS服务器的计费端口。

set system radius-server 192.168.7.252 r.explanation: 配置RADIUS服务器的重试次数。

parameters.explanation: 与RADIUS服务器通信失败后的重试次数。

set system radius-server 192.168.7.252 t.explanation: 配置RADIUS服务器的超时时间。

parameters.name: timeout
parameters.explanation: 与RADIUS服务器通信的超时时间（秒）。

set access profile radius-auth authentic.explanation: 配置访问认证的认证顺序。
